kashika: ते गत्युपसर्गसंज्ञकाः धातोः प्राक् प्रयोक्तव्याः। तथा चैवोदाहृताः। तेग्रहणमुपसर्गार्थम्। गतयो ह्यनन्तराः॥
kashikaEnglish: Gati and upasarga particles are placed before the verb (as prefixes).
englishShort: Words referred as उपसर्ग or गति are attached before the verb root.
englishFull:
The गति and उपसर्ग words are placed BEFORE the verbal root (प्राग्धातोः).

**Principle:** These are prefixes, not suffixes.

**Examples:**
- प्र + कृ → प्रकृत्य (prefix position)
- अस्तम् + गम् → अस्तंगत्य (prefix position)

**Note:** ते in the sūtra refers back to both गति and उपसर्ग.
